headline: China’s Hengrui Posts 89% Surge in Third-Quarter Net Profit, Beating Estimates
summary: Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals reported a 20.55% increase in third-quarter revenue to 8.95 billion yuan ($1.34 billion) and an 88.92% jump in net profit, beating analyst expectations.
why: Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals is one of China’s largest drug makers, serving as an important gauge for China's innovative pharmaceutical sector.

impacts.name: Pharmaceuticals
impacts.why: Strong profit growth driven by innovative drug sales highlights improving margins for Chinese pharmaceutical leaders.

why_moved: Significant earnings beats by major pharmaceutical firms attract positive institutional sentiment.
